correctness.evidence: Independent GF(2) polynomial/codeword enumeration reproduces all three generators' dimensions, Hamming distances, pair distances, spectra, Griesmer boundary sums and Singleton gaps.

originality.evidence: Kurz arXiv:2507.07728 already covers the general optimal parameter landscape, so the triples are not novel. Originality is limited to the explicit cyclic realizations/generators, spectra and exhaustive short cyclic census.

scientific_value.evidence: The compact cyclic constructions and full short-length cyclic census remain useful reproducible benchmark/classification data even though the general parameter optima were already known.

decision: Validated only under a narrowed contribution statement: specific cyclic constructions/spectra/census, not first discovery of the optimal parameter triples.
